note: Eligibility overlay for the canonical P2 roster. One key per source ID. Defaults to denied when absent; raise eligibility only with reviewed six-gate evidence pinned to the accepted root/native pair. Candidate rows record the reported evidence and named blockers; they are not an admission PASS. See docs/PIKMIN2_ENEMY_ROSTER.md.

fields.native_module: engine/pc_port module implementing the identity, or null
fields.owner_lane: family/shared lane that owns the identity
fields.gates: map of the six gate IDs to PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/UNTESTED/N/A; a PASS needs root/native/exe pins, inputs and observed result
fields.delivery_receipt: citation of an actual transport/reward delivery for gate 5 (transport_reward), or null; required for admission
fields.source: list of docs/PIKMIN2_*.md filenames the evidence is transcribed from
fields.notes: free-form review notes (natural vs injected labels)
